digest.component_or_area: LLM model class resolution and verifier routing
propositions: Three independent code paths (verify.py, completion.py, code-review.yaml) select verifier models by comparing cfg.model against DEFAULT_MODEL, causing non-default models to bypass class-based downgrade
Code-review.yaml verify step declares no model key and temperature: 0, so it falls through to cfg.model (frontier) and the temperature setting never takes effect
resolve_model must resolve reserved class names (standard/trivial/frontier) through model_classes.resolve_model_string before falling back to literal model ids
With non-default providers configured, verifier paths must resolve the standard class regardless of cfg.model, preventing silent provider-qualified model strings from defeating equality checks
All three verifier paths must uniformly call resolve_model_string to eliminate the split-brain defect where provider-qualified ids (e.g. anthropic:claude-opus-4-8) bypass the downgrade rule
